structure.unit: Activities Administered by the Department of Conservation and Recreation

law.catch_line: Littering in state parks; civil penalty
law.text: No person shall improperly dispose of litter, as defined in § 10.1-1414, within a Virginia state park. In addition to any penalties that may be assessed under § 10.1-104 or § 33.2-802, any person in violation of this section may be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed $250. All civil penalties imposed under this section shall be deposited in the Conservation Resources Fund.
